label: PF Backlog 579
title: Issue id collision: a local session minted IS-PF-0038 already present on develop
body: During the eventing sync, our clone and develop both held IS-PF-0038 (ours: dogfood PARTIAL_SUCCESS; develop: cross-session double-claim). Issue ids are allocated from a local per-scope counter with no shared cross-session authority (unlike backlog ids), so a diverged clone can mint an id already used upstream.
